# uPlot

[uPlot](https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot) 1.6.32 by Leon Sorokin, MIT (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)). These are the
unmodified `dist/uPlot.iife.min.js` and `dist/uPlot.min.css` from the npm package `uplot@1.6.32`. The report page
inlines them, so a page needs no network to draw its charts.

To update, replace both files from the new npm tarball and change the version here and in the crate README.
